{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age and print it
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()
print(mean_age_converted)"}
